facts.description: Reviewed SFC-licensed corporation or registered institution connecting-broker role
facts.name: connecting_broker

facts.description: Covered tokenised-product secondary trading
facts.name: tokenised_secondary

facts.description: Supplied nonnegative absolute price deviation in exact basis points
facts.name: deviation_bps

facts.description: Illustrative reviewed-policy parameter; 100 is not an SFC-prescribed value
facts.name: threshold_bps

facts.description: Client trading interface displays deviation alert
facts.name: alert_displayed

facts.description: Reviewed reminder of primary-market alternative including applicable implications
facts.name: primary_reminder

interpretations.statement: For a connecting broker facilitating tokenised secondary trading, require the primary-market-alternative reminder. Additionally require a displayed price alert when the supplied absolute deviation from iNAV is greater than the supplied threshold. The threshold and deviation calculation require separate reviewed policies; the circular does not set a fixed percentage.
